history.event: Claude refinement: 34 line(s) suggested — Corrected Kraken's lira sign ⫳ to this manuscript's 𝓎 (cross-barred sign), garbled formula words (spedalingho, gabella, debbo, decta, speze, spedale, parte, berto, largo, digennaio, dinovembre, firēze, nuova, 10/i0→io) and filled in the ruled dashes; the column sums add up (5.14+5.14+2.12+5.14+5.14+2.12 = 𝓎 28 ß 0). | layout: l26: empty sliver box (a stray stroke at the end of l25's bracket); delete; l35, l36, l40: the boxes run into the sums column and include the sum of their entry (in l35 also the sum written inside the line), while l33, l34, l39 are separate sum boxes: the sums are split inconsistently between lines; l29: the box includes the marginal year .1464 at the start of the line; l30: marginal year 1465 sits beside l37 (the 9 [luglio] entry) but is read out of order after l29; l1/l2: marginal title 'lachase dala stalla' split over two boxes | doubts: l27/l29/l32: the year after 146- is the same z-shaped figure in all three entries; Kraken read 3 in l27 but 7 in l29 and l32. I suggest 1463 throughout (the agreement of Feb. 1463, the margin note .1464), but please check it against this hand's 3 and 7; l36/l38: years 1468/1469 left as Kraken read them, though the margin gives 1465 for this group; check the last figure; l9: the word after 'vedova' is illegible to me; 'ꝯfini' is a guess; l23: 'gini' and 'fio' (notaio fiorentino?) are uncertain; 'ß' before names (= ser) kept as Kraken has it; l7: the sign before 'suoi' (con?) is uncertain; Soldi sign: kept ß; CONVENTIONS lists β vs ß as an open question for this manuscript
